description: This file defines the Directory class in a PHP project, which manages directory entries, sorting, and navigation within a content tree structure for documentation or website content.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory node in a content tree, managing child entries, sorting, navigation, and config retrieval.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the children entries into buckets based on naming conventions for order and type.

methods.name: sortBucket
methods.description: Helper method to sort a specific bucket of entries case-insensitively.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds an entry as a child of this directory.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves associated configuration; throws exception if not available.

methods.name: getLocalIndexPage
methods.description: Returns the local index page if present.

methods.name: getIndexPage
methods.description: Returns the index page, considering inheritance settings.

methods.name: seekFirstPage
methods.description: Recursively finds the first available page in descendants.

methods.name: getFirstPage
methods.description: Returns the first page in the directory or its descendants.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the directory or its descendants contain showable content.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Creates a dump of the directory structure and important entries.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a child entry exists at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a child entry by offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing child entries.
